faq.q: What Happens After I Sign a Contract with AltheraCode?
faq.a:
Once the contract is signed, we follow a clear and transparent onboarding process:

1. Team Allocation – Based on your project scope, we assign a dedicated team, including a PM, engineers, QAs, and designers (if needed).
2. Kick-off Meeting – We align on goals, timelines, key stakeholders, and communication channels.
3. Discovery Phase – If required, we run workshops to clarify technical and business requirements.
4. Tech Setup & Planning – We define architecture, sprints, and delivery milestones.
5. Development & Delivery – Agile sprints begin, with weekly/bi-weekly demos and reporting.

We act as your strategic tech partner from day one—ensuring speed, quality, and full transparency.

faq.q: How Much Does Custom Software Development Cost?
faq.a:
The cost of developing custom software depends on multiple factors, including project complexity, required features, technology stack, compliance requirements (if applicable), and team size.
We offer flexible engagement models, such as Time & Material and Dedicated Teams.Contact us for a tailored estimate based on your goals.

faq.q: How Long Does It Take to Develop a Software Solution?
faq.a:
The timeline depends on the project scope and complexity. On average:

- MVP Development: 3–6 months
- AI-powered solutions: 4–8 months
- Enterprise applications: 6+ months
- IoT & remote monitoring systems: Varies based on hardware integration

We use an agile approach to ensure faster iteration cycles and efficient project delivery.

faq.q: Will I Have a Dedicated Project Manager?
faq.a: Yes, every project is assigned a dedicated Project Manager (PM), who ensures clear communication, milestone tracking, and issue resolution throughout the development process.

We work with a versatile tech stack to create scalable and high-performing solutions:

- Back-end: Node.js, Python, .NET, Java
- Front-end: React, Angular, Vue.js
- Mobile: Flutter, React Native
- AI & Machine Learning: TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB

Each project is customized based on business needs and scalability requirements.

faq.q: What Engagement Models Do You Offer?
faq.a:
We provide flexible engagement models to fit different business needs:

- Time & Material – Ideal for evolving projects where flexibility is needed.
- Dedicated Team – A full-time, dedicated team working exclusively on your project.

faq.q: Do You Provide Ongoing Support and Maintenance?
faq.a:
Yes, we offer comprehensive post-launch support, including:

- Performance monitoring & optimizations
- Feature enhancements & system scaling

Our support packages can be tailored based on business priorities and system complexity.

faq.q: What Are the Key Stages of Software Development?
faq.a:
We follow an end-to-end development process to deliver high-quality solutions:

1. Discovery & Analysis – Understanding business needs & defining strategy.
2. Prototyping & UI/UX Design – Creating user-friendly and scalable designs.
3. Development & Integration – Agile development with continuous testing.
4. Quality Assurance – Ensuring high performance and compliance.
5. Deployment & Implementation – Smooth transition to live operations.
6. Post-Launch Support & Scaling – Ongoing maintenance and product improvements.

faq.q: How Do I Choose the Right Software Development Partner?
faq.a:
When selecting a development partner, consider:

- Industry experience & technical expertise – Proven success in your domain.
- Compliance & security measures – Understanding of regulatory requirements.
- Scalability & innovation – Ability to build future-proof solutions.
- Agility & transparent communication – Ensuring efficient collaboration.
